name: Mitten Extracts Live Sauce Infused Preroll | Animal Mintz
description:
Cool mint and sweet earthiness come together in Animal Mintz, delivering a smooth, refreshing flavor with subtle herbal undertones. Crafted with live sauce and liquid diamonds, this strain offers bold terpene flavor and a premium, potent experience.

1.25g Live Sauce Infused Pre-Roll
